quotes.quote: My blade exists only to carve a path for my master. I am his shadow, and his will is my command.
I'm not a bad slime, you know!
Ideals without power are nonsense, and power without ideals is empty.
I will not forgive anyone who lays a finger on my friends. Even if it's a god, I'll make them regret it.
I don't need a reason to help a friend. That's just what friends do.
A king who reigns but doesn't rule. Sounds good to me.
